- Removed the skill-card.md file from the project.

figurine-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI Figurine Generator skill.
- Provides APIs to generate toy design drafts, multi-view reference sheets, and 3D models from prompts and images.
- Supports several toy templates: figurines, stuffed toys, 3D printing, game assets, and architecture models.
- Includes asset sizing for figurines (small, standard, premium).
- Integrates with the OneKey Agent Gateway via an access key.
- Documentation covers API usage, example requests, and output formats.
